title: Localized Hom germ comparison for a complex on the base
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point, $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Ab}(S_{et}))$, $L$ a K-injective cochain complex of abelian etale sheaves on $S$, $r:K\cong QL$, $n\in\mathbf Z$, and $i$ a representative affine pointed neighbourhood. Use the free sheaf and canonical source germ leg of [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs]. Define $E_i$ from $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathbf Z[V_i][0],K[n])$ to $H^n(L(V_i))$ by the bounded-below inclusion, transport by $r$, the K-injective localization bijection, Hom-complex homology, and degreewise free-generator evaluation, exactly as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison], stopping before any stage pullback. Define $b_i:H^n(L(V_i))\to\Gamma(S_{(s)},H^n(g^{-1}K))$ by applying the neighbourhood section restriction of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-restriction] degreewise to $L$, taking homology, using the exact-inverse-image localization comparison, transporting by $g^{-1}r^{-1}$, and commuting exact strict-local sections with homology. These constructions do not choose a representative of a class. Then the canonical source germ leg equals $E_i b_i$. No morphism $f$, base-change mate or fibre cohomology is involved.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 03Q9; cohomology of a K-injective complex and the canonical neighbourhood restriction

proof.text: K-injective localization represents every derived Hom class by a cocycle modulo homotopy. The bounded-below single and shift comparisons and free-generator evaluation identify this quotient with cohomology of L(V_i).

The canonical derived Hom to homology map sends this cocycle to its homology section. Naturality of the presheaf fibre moves that map across the neighbourhood germ. Apply the characterizing equation of the unique strict-henselization stalk restriction to replace that germ by restriction of the same section.

Exact inverse image and exact strict-local sections commute with homology. Their localization factorizations therefore identify the restricted section with the class of the degreewise restricted cocycle. Boundaries remain boundaries, so the identity descends to cohomology. Naturality of the quotient, shift and homology comparisons transports it along r, giving E_i b_i in every integer degree.

theorem sourceLocalizedSectionsIso_germ {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (L : CochainComplex (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    [L.IsKInjective] (r : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (n : ℤ)
    (i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s)) :
    (strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs s K n).app (op i) =
      (sourceLocalizedSectionsIso K L r n ((strictLocalNeighbourhoods s).obj i)).hom ≫
        strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction s K L r n i
